A quick 6-step workflow to take a trading idea from raw data to a validated edge with the help of Claude.

Step 1 - Connect Dhan (MCP)
Claude can place orders, fetch positions, and pull info across NSE, BSE, MCX

Step 2 - Install the Dhan skill
The MCP gives tools, the skill gives know-how (correct API calls, instrument IDs etc)

Step 3 - Download historical data
Ask Claude to pull EOD history.

Step 4 - Build the ratio file
Create a CSV with necessary data for backtest

Step 5 - Define rules and backtest

Ratio breaks above 20-day high → hold NIFTYBEES
Ratio breaks below 20-day low → rotate into GOLDBEES

Step 6 - Validate
From claude to Git to Telegram automated signals every day. Easiest way. Thanks for the idea, used it. It’s already working fine.
